normalizations.description: Leading/trailing blank lines collapsed to exactly one terminal LF. This is the same class of transformation that separates the STO extraction's manifest hash from its on-disk hash, so it is always recorded rather than absorbed.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 0
references.quote: Local amendments to the International Building Code are set out in this section.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 1
references.quote: (a) 101.1, Title, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 2
references.quote: These regulations shall be known as the Building Code of the City of Topeka, Kansas, hereinafter referred to as “this code.”

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 3
references.quote: (b) 101.4.1, Gas, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions for Electrical shall be added:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 4
references.quote: Electrical. The provisions of the electrical code adopted by the City shall apply to the installation of electrical systems, including alterations, repairs, replacement, equipment, appliances, fixtures, fittings and appurtenances thereto.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 5
references.quote: (c) 101.4.2, Mechanical, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 6
references.quote: The provisions of the mechanical code adopted by the City shall apply to the installation, alterations, repairs and replacement of mechanical systems, including equipment, appliances, fixtures, fittings and/or appurtenances, including ventilating, heating, cooling, air-conditioning and refrigeration systems, incinerators and other energy-related systems. All references to the International Mechanical Code contained herein shall instead refer to the mechanical code adopted by the City.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 7
references.quote: (d) 101.4.3, Plumbing, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 8
references.quote: The provisions of the plumbing code adopted by the City shall apply to the installation, alteration, repair and replacement of plumbing systems, including equipment, appliances, fixtures, fittings and appurtenances, and where connected to a water or sewage system and all aspects of a medical gas system. All references to the International Plumbing Code contained herein shall instead refer to the plumbing code adopted by the City.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 9
references.quote: (e) Section 103 is hereby deleted and the provisions of TMC 14.20.030 shall be substituted therefor.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 10
references.quote: (f) 105.2, Work exempt from permit, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 11
references.quote: Exemptions from permit requirements of this code shall not be deemed to grant authorization for any work to be done in any manner in violation of the provisions of this code or any other laws or ordinances of this jurisdiction. Permits shall not be required for the following:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 12
references.quote: Building:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 13
references.quote: 1. One-story detached accessory structures used as tool and storage sheds, playhouses and similar uses, provided the floor area is not greater than 120 square feet (11 m 2 ).

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 14
references.quote: 2. Oil derricks.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 15
references.quote: 3. Retaining walls that are not over 4 feet (1,219 mm) in height measured from the bottom of the footing to the top of the wall, unless supporting a surcharge or impounding Class I, II or IIIA liquids.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 16
references.quote: 4. Water tanks supported directly on grade if the capacity is not greater than 5,000 gallons (18,925 L) and the ratio of height to diameter or width is not greater than 2:1.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 17
references.quote: 5. Painting, papering, tiling, carpeting, cabinets, counter tops and similar finish work.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 18
references.quote: 6. Temporary motion picture, television and theater stage sets and scenery.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 19
references.quote: 7. Prefabricated swimming pools accessory to a Group R-3 occupancy that are less than 24 inches (610 mm) deep, are not greater than 5,000 gallons (18,925 L) and are installed entirely above ground.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 20
references.quote: 8. Shade cloth structures constructed for nursery or agricultural purposes, not including service systems.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 21
references.quote: 9. Swings and other playground equipment accessory to detached one- and two-family dwellings.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 22
references.quote: 10. Window awnings in Group R-3 and U occupancies, supported by an exterior wall that do not project more than 54 inches (1,372 mm) from the exterior wall and do not require additional support.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 23
references.quote: 11. Nonfixed and movable fixtures, cases, racks, counters and partitions not over 5 feet 9 inches (1,753 mm) in height.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 24
references.quote: Electrical:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 25
references.quote: Repairs and maintenance: Minor repair work, including the replacement of lamps or the connection of approved portable electrical equipment to approved permanently installed receptacles.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 26
references.quote: Radio and television transmitting stations: The provisions of this code shall not apply to electrical equipment used for radio and television transmissions, but do apply to equipment and wiring for a power supply and the installations of towers and antennas.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 27
references.quote: Temporary testing systems: A permit shall not be required for the installation of any temporary system required for the testing or servicing of electrical equipment or apparatus.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 28
references.quote: Gas:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 29
references.quote: 1. Portable heating appliance.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 30
references.quote: 2. Replacement of any minor part that does not alter approval of equipment or make such equipment unsafe.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 31
references.quote: Mechanical:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 32
references.quote: 1. Portable heating appliance.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 33
references.quote: 2. Portable ventilation equipment.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 34
references.quote: 3. Portable cooling unit.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 35
references.quote: 4. Steam, hot or chilled water piping within any heating or cooling equipment regulated by this code.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 36
references.quote: 5. Replacement of any part that does not alter its approval or make it unsafe.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 37
references.quote: 6. Portable evaporative cooler.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 38
references.quote: 7. Self-contained refrigeration system containing 10 pounds (4.54 kg) or less of refrigerant and actuated by motors of 1 horsepower (0.75 kW) or less.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 39
references.quote: Plumbing:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 40
references.quote: 1. The stopping of leaks in drains, water, soil, waste or vent pipe, provided, however, that if any concealed trap, drain pipe, water, soil, waste or vent pipe becomes defective and it becomes necessary to remove and replace the same with new material, such work shall be considered as new work and a permit shall be obtained and inspection made as provided in this code.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 41
references.quote: 2. The clearing of stoppages or the repairing of leaks in pipes, valves or fixtures and the removal and reinstallation of water closets, provided such repairs do not involve or require the replacement or rearrangement of valves, pipes or fixtures.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 42
references.quote: (g) Section 106, Floor and Roof Design Loads, is hereby deleted in its entirety.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 43
references.quote: (h) Section 107, Submittal Documents, is hereby amended by the addition of the following provisions:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 44
references.quote: 107.1.1 Code footprint. A code footprint shall be included with each set of construction documents submitted for commercial building permit review and approval. A code footprint shall mean a building and life safety code compliance document that contains both graphic and narrative information and that meets the requirements of this code section and department policy regarding format and regulation.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 45
references.quote: Each code footprint shall be prepared by an architect registered with the State of Kansas. A code footprint shall be prepared for all new buildings, new building additions, changes in occupancy, or building renovation, with the exception of buildings used solely as dwelling houses containing no more than two families.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 46
references.quote: (i) Section 109, Fees, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 47
references.quote: 109.1 General. Whenever any person shall erect, construct, enlarge, alter, repair, move, improve, convert or demolish any building or structure, or cause the same to be done, an application shall be made to the development services office. A permit shall not be valid until the fees prescribed by law have been paid, nor shall an amendment to a permit be released until the additional fee has been paid.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 48
references.quote: Exception: Repair or replacement of less than 50 percent (50%) of roof area will not require a roofing permit. Provided, however, repair or replacement of more than 5,000 square feet of any sized roof shall require a roofing permit.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 49
references.quote: 109.2 Permit fees.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 50
references.quote: 109.2.1 The fee for each permit issued for work to be commenced within the City of Topeka boundaries shall be as prescribed by the City’s fee schedule based on the total valuation ranges set forth in the Table in 109.7, except as provided in 109.6.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 51
references.quote: 109.2.2 The determination of value or valuation under any of the provisions of this code shall be made by the building official. The value to be used in computing the building permit and building plan review fees shall be the total value of all construction work for which the permit is issued, as well as all finish work, painting, roofing, electrical, plumbing, heating, air conditioning, elevators, fire-extinguishing systems and any other permanent equipment.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 52
references.quote: 109.3 Plan review fees. When submittal documents are required by Section 107, a plan review fee as prescribed by the City’s fee schedule shall be paid to the City. The plan review fees specified in this section are separate fees from the permit fees specified in Section 109.2 and are in addition to the permit fees. When submittal documents are incomplete or changed so as to require additional plan review or when the project involves deferred submittal items as defined in Section 107.3.4.1, an additional plan review fee shall be charged as prescribed by the City’s fee schedule.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 53
references.quote: 109.4 Expedited plan review. An applicant requesting a plan review by the division of development services may request an expedited plan review. Expedited plan review will be undertaken by qualified development services employees outside of normal working hours and will not interfere with normal plan review procedures or projects which have been submitted for plan review. An applicant seeking expedited plan review will compensate the City at the rate of two times the plan review fee for the expedited plan review.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 54
references.quote: 109.5 Administrative and other inspection fees.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 55
references.quote: 109.5.1 Administrative fees. In addition to the permitting and other fees permitted in this section, the fees and charges as prescribed by the City’s fee schedule for the following services shall also apply:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 56
references.quote:
Compliance letter
Floodplain verifications
Technology improvement for each permit or license

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 57
references.quote: Compliance letter

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 58

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 59
references.quote: Technology improvement for each permit or license

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 60
references.quote: 109.5.2 Other inspection fees. The following fees shall apply to inspections or certificates of elevators, dumbwaiters, escalators and moving walks:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 61
references.quote:
Annual passenger elevator certificate per unit: | $50.00
Annual freight elevator certificate per unit: | $50.00
Annual escalator certificate per unit: | $35.00
Annual dumbwaiter certificate per unit: | $20.00
Annual access lift certificate per unit: | $20.00
Full load test: | $200.00
Reinspection fee: | $50.00

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 76
references.quote: 109.6 Waiver of fees. Building permit fees and plan review fees as required by this section for building projects with a total valuation of five million dollars ($5,000,000.00) or more may be reduced by the City Manager. Any such reduction shall not to exceed twenty-five percent (25%) of the scheduled fees and must be supported by a determination that the building project will promote economic development and job creation within the City. Any reduction of building permit fees and plan review fees exceeding twenty-five percent (25%) of the scheduled fees shall require approval by resolution of the Governing Body. Notwithstanding the forgoing, no reduction or waiver of building permit fees and plan review fees shall be permitted if: 1) the applicant intends to utilize, or is utilizing, any other City tax incentive, abatement, or economic development program that reduces or rebates ad valorem property tax revenues payable to the City or distributed to the City; or 2) the subject property is exempt from real estate taxation. The fee waiver shall not prohibit the entity from applying for tax incentives from other political and taxing subdivisions of the State.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 77
references.quote: 109.6.1 Building permit and plan review fees may be waived for building projects approved by resolution of the Governing Body provided that the Joint Economic Development Organization reimburses the City in whole for such waived fees. Fees waived pursuant to this subsection and reimbursed by the Joint Economic Development Organization shall not be deemed a reduction or waiver of fees by the City for purposes of Section 109.6 and shall not affect the project’s eligibility for any tax incentive, abatement, or economic development program, including those that reduce or rebate ad valorem property tax revenues payable to the City, whether offered by the City or any other political and taxing subdivisions of the State.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 78
references.quote: 109.6.2. The City Manager is authorized to consider fee waivers in cases of: (1) emergency situations; and (2) affordable or charitable housing projects where materials and labor are donated.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 95
references.quote: 109.8 Work commencing before permit issuance. Any person who commences any work on a building, structure, electrical, gas, mechanical or plumbing system before obtaining the necessary permits shall be subject to a fee as prescribed by the City’s fee schedule that shall be in addition to the required permit fees.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 96
references.quote: 109.9 Related fees. The payment of the fee for the construction, alteration, removal or demolition for work done in connection to or concurrently with the work authorized by a building permit shall not relieve the applicant or holder of the permit from the payment of other fees that are prescribed by law.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 97
references.quote: 109.10 Refunds. The building official is authorized to establish a refund policy.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 98
references.quote: (j) 110.3.9, Energy efficiency inspections, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 99
references.quote: Inspections shall be made to determine compliance with Chapter 13 and shall include, but not be limited to, inspections for: envelope insulation R- and U-values and fenestration U-value.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 100
references.quote: (k) 111.1, Change of occupancy, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 101
references.quote: When issuance of a building permit is required and building official inspection approval is obtained, building or structure shall not be used or occupied, and a change in the existing use or occupancy classification of a building or structure or portion thereof shall not be made, until the building official has issued a certificate of occupancy therefor as provided herein. Issuance of a certificate of occupancy shall not be construed as an approval of a violation of the provisions of this code or of other ordinances of the jurisdiction.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 102
references.quote: Exception: Certificates of occupancy are not required for work exempt from permits in accordance with Section 105.2.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 103
references.quote: 111.1.1 Except as provided in section 111.1.2, no certificate of occupancy shall be issued unless the driveway approaches have been installed and sidewalks constructed along all adjoining rights-of-way of the subject lot or all lots or portions thereof joined to it or are the subject of a contract as part of a benefit district created pursuant to K.S.A. 12-6a01 et seq. or Appendix A , Article XII of the Topeka Municipal Code.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 104
references.quote: 111.1.2 The Director of Planning or designee may waive the requirement of section 111.1.1 if either of the following conditions applies:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 105
references.quote: (1) The sidewalk is the subject of a waiver granted in conjunction with approval of the subdivision plat.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 106
references.quote: (2) Unique circumstances exist where the Director of Planning or designee determine that the subject sidewalk link would not be part of a viable sidewalk system in that community or conditions exist whereby construction of the sidewalk is impractical.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 107
references.quote: (3) Weather conditions prevented installation of the driveway approaches or construction of the sidewalks. However, in such event, the property owner shall install driveway approaches and construct sidewalks within 90 days from the date of the final inspection.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 108
references.quote: 111.1.3 Issuance of a certificate of occupancy shall not be construed as an approval of a violation of the provisions of this code or of other ordinances.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 109
references.quote: (l) Section 113, Means of Appeals, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 110
references.quote: Appeals of orders, decisions or determinations made by the building official relative to the application and interpretation of this code shall be in accordance with TMC 2.235.010 .

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 175
references.quote: Note: Thresholds located in Section 903.2 unless noted. See also Table 903.2.11.6 for additional required suppression systems. For SI: 1 foot = 304.8 mm, 1 square foot = 0.0929 m 2 .

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 176
references.quote: (n) 903.2.1.2, Group A-2, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 177
references.quote: An automatic sprinkler system shall be provided throughout stories containing Group A-2 occupancies and throughout all stories from the Group A-2 occupancy to and including the levels of exit discharge serving that occupancy where one of the following conditions exists:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 178
references.quote: 1. The fire area exceeds 5,000 square feet (464.5 m 2 ).

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 179
references.quote: 2. The fire area has an occupant load of 100 or more.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 180
references.quote: Exception: The fire area occupant load may be allowed from 100 to 299 occupants with the following provisions:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 181
references.quote: (i) Required exits provided are increased a minimum of 50%, in accordance with Sections 1007.1.2 and 1016.2.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 182
references.quote: (ii) A manual fire alarm system that activates occupant notification system and automatic fire detection is installed in accordance with Sections 907.4 and 907.5.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 183
references.quote: 3. The fire area is located on a floor other than the level of exit discharge serving such occupancies.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 184
references.quote: (o) 903.2.8, Group R, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 185
references.quote: An automatic sprinkler system installed in accordance with Section 903.3 shall be provided throughout all buildings with a Group R fire area.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 186
references.quote: Exceptions:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 187
references.quote: 1. An automatic sprinkler system is not required for buildings containing a maximum of two (2) single family dwelling units within a mixed-use building with other nonresidential occupancies if the following conditions are met:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 188
references.quote: (i) A fire alarm and detection system is installed in the residential units as well as the nonresidential occupancy areas.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 189
references.quote: (ii) A fire-resistive barrier of 2-hour fire resistance as required by Section 707 of the IBC, between commercial and residential occupancies. And 1-hour fire resistance between dwelling units.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 190
references.quote: 2. An automatic sprinkler system is not required for a building containing a maximum of four (4) single family dwelling units within single use building classified as R occupancy with dwelling units separated from each other by vertical wall assemblies having not less than 2-hour fire-resistive barrier as required in Section 707 of the IBC. Where dwelling units are arranged above or below adjacent units, separation of units shall be provided with horizontal assemblies complying with Section 711.2, and are limited to two stores above grade plane. The following conditions must also be met:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 191
references.quote: (i) A interconnected smoke alarm installed in each dwelling unit.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 192
references.quote: (ii) roofs shall have a minimum of Class C roof covering and the decking or sheathing shall be of a non-combustible materials or approved fire-retardant-treated wood for a distance of 4 feet on each side of the walls.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 193
references.quote: (iii) There shall be no penetrations through this area of the roof deck or sheathing within distances less than required by other provisions of the IBC.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 194
references.quote: (p) 1101.1, Scope, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 195
references.quote: The provisions of this chapter and Appendix E shall control the design and construction of facilities for accessibility for individuals with disabilities. Accessibility under this code, including all references within this code, shall be governed by the applicable City ordinances, State and Federal statutes and implementing regulations.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 196
references.quote: (q) Section 1808.1, General, is hereby amended by the addition of the following:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 197
references.quote: 1808.1.1 Footing depth. Unless otherwise designed per provisions of a specific type of foundation, the minimum depth of footings shall be 36 inches (915 mm) below finished grade and bearing on undisturbed ground and shall conform to the design requirements per this section.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 198
references.quote: Exception: Only as determined and approved by the building official in accordance with design provisions of a specific type of foundation.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 199
references.quote: (r) 1809.1, General, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 200
references.quote: Shallow foundations shall be designed and constructed in accordance with Sections 1808.1.1 and 1809.2 through 1809.13.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 201
references.quote: (s) 3104.1.1, Application, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 202
references.quote: Pedestrian walkways shall be designed and constructed in accordance with Sections 3104.2 through 3104.9. Tunnels shall be designed and constructed in accordance with Section 3104.2 and 3104.10.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 203
references.quote: (t) 3107.1, General, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 204
references.quote: Signs shall be designed, constructed and maintained in accordance with this code. Placement, type of sign, height and other requirements shall be governed by the Topeka Municipal Code.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 205
references.quote: (u) 3109.1, General, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 206
references.quote: The design and construction of swimming pools, spas and hot tubs shall comply with the International Swimming, Pool and Spa Code, Additionally, provisions of the International Property Maintenance Code as adopted are applicable.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 207
references.quote: (v) 3201.3, Other laws, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 208
references.quote: Regulation of public rights-of-way; encroachments. The City has a right to regulate public rights-of-way for the benefit of the public. Encroachments into the public right-of-way that solely benefit a private person or organization will not be allowed unless the applicant demonstrates that any private benefit is incidental and there is an overall benefit to the public.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 209
references.quote: (w) 3202.3, Encroachments 8 feet or more above grade, is hereby deleted in its entirety and the following provisions shall be substituted therefor:

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 210
references.quote: Encroachments 8 feet (2,438 mm) or more above grade shall comply with Sections 3202.3.1 through 3202.3.4.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 211
references.quote: 3202.3.1 Awnings, canopies, and marquees. Awnings, canopies, and marquees shall be constructed so as to support applicable loads as specified in Chapter 16. Awnings, canopies, and marquees with less than 15 feet (4,572 mm) clearance above the sidewalk shall not extend into or occupy more than two-thirds the width of the sidewalk measured from the building. Stanchions or columns that support awnings, canopies, marquees and signs shall be located not less than 2 feet (610 mm) in from the curb line.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 212
references.quote: 3202.3.2 Windows, balconies, architectural features, signs and mechanical equipment. Where the vertical clearance above grade to projecting windows, balconies, architectural features, signs or mechanical equipment is more than 8 feet (2,438 mm), 1 inch (25 mm) of encroachment is permitted for each additional 1 inch (25 mm) of clearance above 8 feet (2,438 mm), but the maximum encroachment shall be 4 feet (1,219 mm).

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 213
references.quote: 3202.3.3 Encroachments 15 feet or more above grade.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 214
references.quote: 3202.3.3.1 Encroachment of awnings, canopies, or marquees 15 feet or more above grade. Awnings, canopies, and marquees shall be constructed so as to support applicable loads as specified in Chapter 16. Awnings, canopies, marquees and signs with 15 feet (4,572 mm) or more clearance above the sidewalk shall not extend into or occupy more than two-thirds the width of the sidewalk measured from the building. Stanchions or columns that support awnings, canopies, or marquees shall not be located or placed in the public right-of-way.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 215
references.quote: 3202.3.3.2 Encroachments of windows, balconies, architectural features, signs, and mechanical equipment 15 feet or more above grade. Encroachment of windows, balconies, architectural features, signs, and mechanical equipment of 15 feet (4,572 mm) or more above grade shall be limited to 4 feet and the encroachment shall not be supported by columns, stanchions or other vertical supports placed or located in the public right-of-way.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 216
references.quote: 3202.3.5 Pedestrian walkways. The vertical clearance from the public right-of-way to the lowest part of a pedestrian walkway shall be 15 feet (4,572 mm) minimum.

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 217
references.quote: (x) Chapter 35, Referenced Standards, is hereby amended to include the NFPA 54, National Fuel Gas Code, as a referenced standard. (Ord. 20671 § 1, 7-14-26; Ord. 20648 § 2, 4-14-26.)

references.label: TMC 14.20.060 block 218
references.quote: Cross References: City Council – Mayor, Chapter 2.15 TMC; Planning and Development Department, TMC 2.20.080 ; Board of Appeals, TMC 2.235.010 .
